candidate_reports.remark: Personal weather station Logia Flora Parke - KFLFERNA293 measured 3.25 inches of rain. About 2.7 inches fell between 1 and 2 PM EDT. Rain began around 11 AM EDT.
Personal weather station Wollitz Station - KFLHILLI71 measured 3.16 inches of rain. Rain began around 150 PM EDT.
Personal weather station Riverhouse - KFLJACKS4624 measured 2.44 inches of rain. About 2.3 inches fell between 230 and 330 PM EDT. Rain began around 1255 PM EDT.
Minor street flooding was reported along NW 244th Terrace and NW 32nd Ave. A nearby pasture was also flooded which usually only floods during tropical systems.
Personal weather station My Home - KFLNEWBE35 measured v3.04 inches of rain. Rain began at 1255 PM EDT. About 2.3 inches of rain fell between 445 and 545 PM.
Multiple images shared via social media of a funnel cloud. Time estimated via radar and social media information.
